neighbours.label: an abstract quality noun used as a countable instance ('with a reverence', 'a sweetness and honesty', 'a speed and responsiveness'), as against the same quality nouns in plain possessive or bare use
fire: The old man spoke of the war with a bitterness that surprised us.
She plays the slow movement with a tenderness few pianists manage.
The novel has a warmth and generosity that carry it to the end.
He handled the injured bird with a gentleness we had not seen before.
The young team showed a calm and patience beyond their years.
Her letters have a frankness and humour that make them easy to read.
The monks greeted the visitors with a courtesy that felt ancient.
The singer brings a sadness and longing to the old folk song.
